device.basis: Flash reads go through the aperture at 0xf0000000+offset by CPU copies and DMA; the controller's configuration words are written around each copy. Commands: +0x00 opcode, +0x04 aperture address, +0x10 control (chip select in bits 6-7), +0x20 phase count, +0x1c start; +0x24 status and +0x28 mask, where a set mask bit also acknowledges its status. Page programs are aperture stores while the registers hold opcode 0x12, ended by +0x30 bit 0. X-T20 2.11 driver 0xc5182c/0xc5220c; its handler 0xc501c0 is connected through descriptor 0xed4804, interrupt 0x23.
